title: Personal tenderness becomes tangible warmth

captions.physics: Freely offering attention towards each other

meaning: Your attention can bring simple pleasure when closeness is freely chosen and leaves room for an actual response.
text: Tenderness can take a very simple form. In the physical position of Anahata, the Lovers express care through mutually offered attention: lingering nearby, embracing or answering an invitation. The Lovers in energy have a different role, the wish to choose your connection personally rather than merely fulfil a duty. The Empress in emotions offers pleasure in received warmth. It feels good to discover that your attention was welcome. One guarantees neither of the others, but a living agreement understandable to both can emerge between them.

For example, you are about to return to separate tasks when one person suggests sitting together a little longer. The other willingly stays, turning an ordinary pause into a warm meeting. **Freely received attention can make the simplest moment pleasant.** No special occasion or demonstration of serious intention was needed. Care appeared through wanting to remain nearby. A phone can be set aside, a comfortable place found and warmth felt now, without making it a promise of another compulsory evening.

The pleasant moment grows restrictive when extended regardless of the answer. Another minute, another conversation and another confirmation make leaving difficult without guilt. Pleasure in care becomes responsibility for another person’s mood. Tenderness stays mutual when willingness to stop matters alongside the wish to begin. A freely shared meeting can end without its warmth being devalued.
